title: Integrated wordmark
brief: The original interleaved A becomes the first letter of ANANKE.
criteria: Keep the A; use Anton uppercase; tuck the first N into the right-hand whitespace.

concepts.name: Integrated A + NANKE
concepts.idea: One A, one name: the symbol starts the word.
rationale: Colours derived from current documentation tokens

recommendation: Use the dark integrated wordmark for documentation; keep the standalone A for icons.
next_steps: Accepted logo and icons installed in the documentation source; deployment is separate.
